evidence.quote: As long as inflation doesn't rebound and stay elevated, I believe the FOMC will be able to lower the target range for the federal funds rate this year.
I see no reason to move as quickly or cut as rapidly as in the past.
I am becoming more confident that we are within striking distance of achieving a sustainable level of 2 percent PCE inflation.
Today, I view the risks to our employment and inflation mandates as being more closely balanced.
So, from now on, the setting of policy needs to proceed with more caution to avoid over-tightening.
These are all signs that the labor market continues to come into better balance.
